title: RideLink Local Round Trip Mileage — Distance Band Schedule
content:
Each local round trip between the lodging and the facility on a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip with an overnight stay adds a set number of miles to the approved miles, according to how far the facility is from home.

**Rule.** Each local round trip adds miles set by the outbound leg's registered one-way miles: at or above the metro trip miles of 200, it adds the metro local miles of 14.0; at or above the regional trip miles of 150 but under 200, it adds the regional local miles of 8.0; under 150, it adds none. The approved miles are the round trip plus the local round trips times the miles each adds.

## Distance bands

| Outbound leg's registered one-way miles | Miles added per local round trip |
|---|---|
| 200 or more | 14.0 |
| 150 to under 200 | 8.0 |
| Under 150 | None |

## Boundary rows

| Hypothetical outbound one-way miles | Miles per local round trip |
|---|---|
| 149.9 | None |
| 150.0 | 8.0 |
| 199.9 | 8.0 |
| 200.0 | 14.0 |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical trip:* outbound and return legs of 210.0 one-way miles each, with 4 local round trips. The round trip is 420.0 miles; the local round trips add 4 times 14.0, that is 56.0 miles; the approved miles are 476.0.

*Hypothetical trip:* legs of 160.0 miles each, with 3 local round trips: 320.0 miles plus 3 times 8.0, giving 344.0 approved miles.
